title: You Mined Your Last Block
description: Minecraft mod that kills player(s) after a random amount of blocks have been mined in a world
body:
In this mod, a random number of blocks is generated for each world. Players can mine and craft as they always have! Until a random number of blocks is mined...

Once a random number of blocks is mined, all players on the world are killed and are given the option to spectate the world or leave. Inspired by this clip (start at 0:25): [https://youtu.be/335cz7AhBFY?si=8v5EnVsIvlHA9Ln3&t=25](https://youtu.be/335cz7AhBFY?si=8v5EnVsIvlHA9Ln3&t=25)

Has implementation configuration screen to turn on/off mod within game as well as random block generation limit.
